compareDisposition.rationale: No distinct two-source pairing adds more than this passage and its existing Scripture connections.

observations.body: The children of Israel went forward on their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud stayed in the wilderness of Paran.
observations.label: Text in view

observations.body: The cloud and the camp move from Sinai toward Paran.
observations.label: The camp departs

observations.body: Cloud, trumpet, and tribal order govern movement away from Sinai toward Paran.
observations.label: Wilderness role

payload.posture: Read Numbers 10:10–14 as its own wilderness scene before relating it to other journeys, memories, or visions.
payload.tension: The cloud marks the next stage without revealing what will happen there.
payload.title: Israel departs Sinai
